title: WMS Ticket Workflow 1.22.4 — Steps và Gates
description: Package wms 1.22.4, graph wms-lifecycle@7: trace chính bug / feature tới deliverable-ready, node IF / HT theo family, và trace review-fix sau PR.

lanes.label: Sau PR · review-fix (14 node, gộp 5 nhóm)

nodes.label: Preparation
nodes.detail: preparation · 1 worker Sonnet (C1) · đọc ticket, repo, DB, API, thiết bị, bạn chọn môi trường, tạo worktree, doctor → environment.md · G7: thiếu ticket.md / repos.env → dừng

nodes.label: Requirement
nodes.detail: requirement-analysis (feature) · 1 worker Sonnet + 1 reviewer Opus · → investigation.md · G1

nodes.label: Impact analysis
nodes.detail: impact-analysis (feature) · 1 worker Sonnet, không reviewer · không gate

nodes.label: Feature plan
nodes.detail: feature-plan (trước @7: implementation-plan-approval) · 1 worker Sonnet · Gate A + 16 rule STACK thiết kế · G3 · G0 bạn duyệt

nodes.label: Investigate
nodes.detail: investigate (bug, gộp root-cause từ @4) · 1 worker Opus C3 · kuroda-kanbei Opus 1 lần nếu --advice · G1

nodes.label: Fix plan
nodes.detail: fix-plan (trước @7: fix-plan-approval) · 1 worker Opus C3 · bảng Condition → negative case · Gate A + 16 rule STACK thiết kế · G3 · G0 bạn duyệt

nodes.label: Coding
nodes.detail: coding (trước @7: implement) · 1 worker Sonnet · rules-coding.json, bảng Rule self-check · verify-subject · G6 · G7

nodes.label: Coding review
nodes.detail: coding-review (trước @7: implementation-review) · 2 worker Opus (mechanical + semantic) → controller phán · Gate B C J S (+I) · chưa đạt → coding · lần 2 → G4

nodes.label: IF registration
nodes.detail: bug: if-registration-integrity-or-update · feature: if-registration · Gate E F K · rồi if-real-path-verification-import / -export (Gate A)

nodes.label: Testcase
nodes.sublabel: Workbook 単体テスト仕様書
nodes.detail: testcase · 1 worker Sonnet · bug IF: testcase-update (Opus C3) · G5

nodes.label: Testcase review
nodes.detail: testcase-review · 1 worker Opus C3 · tối đa 2 vòng · G4 · G5

nodes.label: Execute + evidence
nodes.detail: execute-and-evidence · 1 worker Sonnet + 1 reviewer Opus · doctor --e2e ≤ 72h · Gate J · G6

nodes.label: Handheld
nodes.detail: handheld-verification (chỉ ticket HT) · 1 worker Sonnet + 1 reviewer Opus · G6

nodes.label: Tech checklist
nodes.detail: tech-checklist-review (trước @5: w3-technical) · 1 worker Opus C3 mọi repo · Gate ALL (A–K + S) · receipt mỗi repo 72h

nodes.label: Delivery drafts
nodes.detail: delivery-drafts · 1 worker Sonnet · đúng 6 file

nodes.label: Deliverable ready
nodes.detail: deliverable-ready · wf.py receipts → ready → bạn duyệt nháp → wms-ship · cần ≥ 24h hạn receipt

nodes.label: Read PR review
nodes.detail: post-pr → wf.py handback → read-pr-review · check-review-is-current

nodes.label: Verify claim
nodes.detail: reload-ticket-and-spec · verify-review-claim · decide-fix-scope · check-sibling-ifs (Gate K)

nodes.label: Reopen node
nodes.detail: reopen-earliest-invalidated-node · không dispatch

nodes.label: Fix + rerun
nodes.detail: apply-review-fix · rerun-affected-evidence · tech-checklist-review round two · delivery-drafts

nodes.label: Re-ship
nodes.detail: reship-ready · reply-to-pr-review · wms-ship re-ship · recheck-pr-review

edges.label: bạn ký · wms-ship mở PR · review ngoài

cards.title: Phân tích · preparation → plan
items: Preparation — đọc ticket, repo, DB, API; bạn chọn môi trường; worktree; doctor (G7)
Bug: Investigate (Opus) — chứng minh nguyên nhân; root-cause đã gộp vào đây (G1)
Fix plan (Opus) / Feature plan (Sonnet) — Gate A + 16 rule STACK thiết kế · G3 · G0 bạn duyệt

cards.title: Triển khai và review · coding → testcase-review
items: Coding review — 2 worker Opus, Gate B C J S (+I); chưa đạt → coding, lần 2 → G4
Chỉ ticket IF — registration Gate E F K, real-path Gate A
Testcase → Testcase review (Opus), tối đa 2 vòng (G4 · G5)

cards.title: Xác minh và bàn giao · e2e → ready
items: Execute + evidence — test thật, ảnh, DB trước sau (Gate J · G6)
Tech checklist (Opus) — Gate ALL (A–K + S), receipt mỗi repo 72h
Delivery drafts — 6 file · Deliverable ready → wms-ship

cards.title: Sau PR · review-fix
items: 14 node gộp 5 nhóm: đọc review → xác minh claim → mở lại node → sửa + chạy lại → re-ship
Còn finding ACCEPTED → quay lại post-pr
